view_claims.claim: `src/eval_lab/lint_evidence.py` defines the evidence-result states AVAILABLE, UNKNOWN and INTEGRITY_FAILURE, and `RawRecord.field` prevents damaged-record values from supplying available support.

`src/eval_lab/lint_evidence.py::RawRecord.presence` distinguishes a missing optional slot from an explicitly present null slot, returning UNKNOWN for the former and an AVAILABLE false presence value for the latter.

`src/eval_lab/lint_prerequisites.py::DirectRecords` reuses `RawReader.read` for exact integrity checks, and the temporal collection access checks the explicit direct inventory against enumerated identities.

`src/eval_lab/lint_temporal_prerequisites.py` and `src/eval_lab/lint_warrant_prerequisites.py` declare fields in SPECS and append their present obligation logs while reading, so those logs alone do not enumerate a declared field that was never read.

The integrated temporal attachment handler returns without derivative traversal only when checked frame indices are empty and derivative presence is false, and otherwise checks attachment correspondence.
The integrated temporal sample handler checks a supplied sample design even when no generation-plan reference is active.

`src/eval_lab/lint_warrant_prerequisites.py` already uses parsed timestamps for registration/view correspondence and contains a FirstView content-correspondence guard with focused controls in `tests/test_lint_warrant_prerequisites.py`.
`loop/config.toml` sets max_changed_lines to 900, and `loop/gates.py` counts added plus removed non-generated lines, including untracked text files.

The L12-A2d1a entry in `loop/backlog.toml` authorizes no new dependency, protected-file edit or existing-test weakening, while its inherited operator constraint requires a size stop above 500 lines at the literal-inventory/deleted-real-read checkpoint.

`loop/proposals/APPROVED-L12-A2d1-split.toml` assigns temporal/warrant accounting to d1a and role/history/computed/all-rule accounting to d1b; the active backlog notes keep complete semantic work outside both children.
